who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), port lane of blaze-lower onto blaze-memo, port-memo-1113
what: An Edit with nothing written still makes a new snapshot on commit(), so every caller that may write nothing (a refresh of an unmoved view, surfaces given again) has to ask Edit::moved() first, or tests that say 'nothing is written' see the epoch move.
cost: a base-db addition (Edit::moved, Files::has_marks) and two helpers in blaze-lower that every write path must remember to call
cause: commit() decides nothing about whether there is anything to commit: the no-op check is left to each caller
class: a commit primitive whose no-op case is the caller's job, so each new write path can make an empty snapshot that drops nothing but costs an epoch
prevention: have Edit::commit return the old snapshot's epoch unchanged when moved() is false, and delete commit_edit/commit_moved
workaround: blaze-lower's commit_edit(edit) / commit_moved(db): commit only when edit.moved(), else leave_open
